Based loosely on the novels by James Gurney, Dinotopia is a fantasy adventure series following two young brothers who wash up on the shore of the titular island, a magical lost paradise where humans and dinosaurs live together. Karl and David Scott are half-brothers enjoying a flight with their father on his private aircraft when tragedy strikes and the plane crashes to the ground. When they wash up on land, their adventure begins, learning about this hidden civilisation and begin to adjust to their surroundings. The three-episode show aired in 2002, starring Wentworth Miller, Tyron Leitso, and David Thewlis.

Awakened after a fifty year rest, the supreme sorcerer Merlin returns to Camelot to find the kingdom in ruins, depleted after the theft of the Holy Grail, its greatest form of protection. Seeking help, he employs the services of a young thief and beggar by the name of Jack, himself a man of magical talent. Merlin and Jack set out to discover the whereabouts of the Holy Grail, with Jack now his apprentice, but they find the kingdom on the brink of attack and doom. The 2006 two-part series is a sequel to the original 1998 series, with Sam Neill and Miranda Richardson reprising their roles as Merlin and the Lady of the Lake.

This re-telling of the eighteen century novel of the same name, by H. Rider Haggard, features Patrick Swayze. The main character (Swayze), is called Allan Quatermain and is a treasure hunter in search this time, of King Solomon's hidden treasure. With the help of a group of people, one of which is a woman trying to locate her father, Sir Henry, who went missing years ago, they embark on the dangerous journey. On their coat tails is a group of hostile and violent African tribesmen and a fellow explorer.

Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's Sherlock Holmes - the world's greatest detective - faces a most alluring adversary... Legendary opera star Irene Adler is threatening to destroy the King of Bohemia's reputation with proof of their illicit affair. The evidence? A photograph. Her ransom? The king's hand in marriage. But not only does investigating detective Sherlock Holmes already know Irene from the past, he also knows that the queen of manipulation would never resort to such a common crime. After uncovering her true ambitions, Holmes draws the cunning songstress into a well-matched game of cat and mouse.

In 1998, three white men in the small town of Jasper, Texas, chained a black man to the back of their pickup truck and dragged him to his death. This film relates that story and how it affected all of the residents of the town, both black and white.

Charlie works for a company that is taken over by Walcott who believes family values are a priority. Career-driven Charlie does a little fibbing when under the pressure of Walcott's standards, and believes she's in the clear. But when Walcott invites himself over for dinner, she borrows her friend's house and daughter and hires actor Buck to play her husband for the evening. The one-night "act" turns into a full-time gig when her boss decides to rent the house next door for the summer, forcing Charlie and Buck to stay together in the fake lifestyle she created.
Horror starring Jeri Ryan. A mother and her two daughters move into an ancient house in a suburb of Detroit, when it is offered at a lower price than usual.
Jennifer fears for Jonathan's life when ruthless jewel thieves take him hostage during a robbery while he's on a business trip in Paris.

Drama starring Edward Asner (ʻLou Grantʼ). A soldier serving in Afghanistan is touched by an anonymous Christmas card sent by a woman in California. Upon completion of his tour of duty, he returns to the United States on a romantic mission to find the woman who wrote the card.

Zoom In is a TV series that helps us to peep into the inside of the magic process of film making. It is an exciting trip to the hottest movies production. Get the insiders' look at the budget and the crew all in just seven minutes. Top actors and actresses, writers, producers and directors share a part of their secrets about their job. See with your own eyes the action scenes from shooting and find out what it is really like to make a movie.

Dr. Jeff: Rocky Mountain Vet is a TV series entirely dedicated to love and care for animals. Thanks to a genius Dr. Jeff Young Denver's Planned Pethood Plus veterinary clinic is always busy and is taking care of 80,000-plus clients and their pets. Dr. Jeff's sharp surgical skills and his unconditional love for animals make him one of the most respected vets in the country. Dr. Jeff has a dedicated team of more than 30 veterinary staffers and once a month they go to remote locations where people do not have access to vets.

US reality TV show follows the Irwin family through their adventures in continuing Steve Irwin's legacy. The family share their wildlife experiences from their travels across the world. They show how they care for all the animals while giving insight into their family life at Australia Zoo where they live and work. The Australian family including mother Terri who is a naturalist and conservationist stars alongside daughter Bindi and son Robert who are fully immerse in animal life and their family.

Reality-documentary series following the lives of the aquatic inhabitants at the Georgia Aquarium. The largest in the United States and fourth-largest in the world, the aquarium boasts a wide range of diverse inhabitants and explores the relationship between animals and trainers. The 10-million-gallon (38-million-litre) facility plays home to over 500 marine species including endangered penguins, rescued sea otters and recovering sea lions. The show reveals the difficulties that come with nursing and caring for such a wide variety of species. With many heart-warming scenes, the series beautifully reveals the friendships between the different species and how they learn to co-exist with each other.

Pit bulls are eager to please, faithful and enthusiastic friends and pleasant with children according to credible canine organizations. But they have fallen from grace. Now often associated with gang members, dog fighting and attacks. That's about to change. Animal Planet introduces you to this dog's greatest ally, and she's not a man - she's a fiery red-headed leading lady, and she's determined to end the needless hostility toward pit bulls. Meet Tia Maria Torres - 49-year-old mother, top pit bull trainer and founder and owner of Villalobos Rescue Center - the country's largest rescue facility for pit bulls.

Jackson Galaxy is a cat behaviorist. He is the person who resolves conflicts or behavioral issues between the owners and their cats or even between the cats and other pets. These are attacks and misbehavior, and Jackson is a true cat-lover and a believer that any problem can be solved thanks to love, patience and proper handling. Taking good care of cats is a demanding process and a whole science, but in return you will get a loving and purring family member.

Treehouse Masters is an American reality television series hosted by Pete Nelson, a treehouse builder. Pete and his team design and build all types of treehouses for clients across the country. The clients and Pete's team are the people who never stop dreaming. You'll be surprised to know how many people want to get away from the noisy comfortable cities and live in close communion with mother nature. So getting a treehouse is their chance to live a dream. Every episode will amaze you because of Pete's talent and incredible imagination. He can build any type of a treehouse, starting from a small simple ones to most complex residences with all modern communication. Every wish of a customer will be heard and fulfilled.

Extinct or Alive is an Animal Planet documentary show exploring the possible existence of animals thought to be extinct. Biologist and explorer Forrest Galante follows real life stories and visits wildlife locations across the planet, hoping to discover proof that animals such as the Zanzibar leopard or the Galapagos tortoise still exist. Find out if his methods will bring new exciting discoveries. Could animals we think are extinct for a century still be found in nature?

Follow aquarium enthusiasts Brett Raymer and Wayde King as they attempt to build some of the most luxurious fish tanks in the world. At Acrylic Tank Manufacturing, the brothers-in-law guide you through the design process and the building of their truly jaw-dropping aquariums. Experience the unveiling of finished tanks housed everywhere from restaurants and banks, to glamorous casinos and mansions. Join the duo in their Las Vegas workshop as they deliver some budget-shattering builds to their high-profile clientele.

In the series premiere of THE LAST ALASKANS, three families living in the Arctic National Wildlife Refuge prepare for the upcoming winter due to arrive in just four weeks. It is September in Alaska, and Heimo and Edna Korth set out to hunt down the tail end of a caribou migration. Bob Harte arrives at his cabin to find it was ransacked by a young grizzly bear, destroying two years of his food supply, which ultimately forces Bob to fly his small single propeller plane to a tiny village located hundreds of miles away to resupply. The Lewis family of five arrives at the refuge with hope as signs of life have returned to the land surrounding their home after a wildfire forced most of the native animals to flee three years earlier. Once settled, Ray and his teenage daughters compete with hungry wolves to take down a moose in order to feed their family throughout the harsh winter. Later, both Heimo and Bob confront the personal tragedies that come with living in extreme isolation nearly 400 miles from civilization.

The story follows the work of the dedicated staff of Gulf Coast veterinary clinic, an emergency animal hospital where patients that require critical care are treated by professionals trained to handle a variety of services, ranging from routine check-ups to extremely complex veterinary procedures.

This reality TV show follows Marty Raney and his two children, Matt Raney and Misty Bilodeau, who are successful homesteaders from the state of Alaska and have the skills needed to fish, hunt, raise livestock, and otherwise survive in an untamed landscape. Struggling homesteaders across the country call these experts to help them save their homesteads and become self-sufficient while they teach them the necessary skills to survive the wilderness.

Jaunasis Dogtanjanas svajoja prisijungti prie legendinių šunietininkų. Įrodęs savo įgūdžius ir užsitarnavęs pasitikėjimą, jis kartu su šunietininkais turi apginti karalių nuo piktojo kardinolo Rišeljė slapto sąmokslo užgrobti valdžią. Jiems niekas nebaisu, nes jų šūkis - "Vienas už visus ir visi už vieną!" Originalus pavadinimas "Dogtanian and the Three Muskehounds".

Jaunai programuotojai Mei pasiūlomas darbas vienoje didžiausių pasaulio technologijų bendrovių "Ratas". Naujoji "Ratas" technologija – visą vartotojo gyvenimą fiksuojanti mini kamera, susieta su socialiniais tinklais. Tai nenutrūkstamas realybės šou. Kompanija tiki, kad naujoji jų sukurta technologija padės išvaduoti pasaulį nuo nusikaltimų, prisidės prie atviros ir teisingos visuomenės kūrimo. Tačiau netikėtai Mei ima pažinti kitą technologijų pusę. Ar gali būti, kad tai – tik fasadas, slepiantis visiškai kitokius tikslus?

Karalienės šuniukas Reksis visuomet mėgo išdaigas, tačiau jo mielumas greitai ištirpdydavo net ir didžiausią paniurėlį. Jis greitai tapo karališkųjų rūmų numylėtiniu. Deja, patogus gyvenimas pasisuka netikėta linkme. Pikti žmonės Reksį sugauna ir uždaro į narvą. Visą gyvenimą praleidęs rūmuose, jis atsiduria tarp gatvėse išaugusių šunų, kurie nuolat urzgia ir kaunasi vienas su kitu. Reksis turės pasitelkti visą savo išmonę, gudrumą ir protą, kad išsaugotų sveiką kailį bei grįžtų į saugius ir jaukius namus.

Filmas sukurtas pagal tikrus įvykius. Neseniai šeimą sukūrę, vienas kitą mylintys jaunuoliai augina dvi dukreles ir siekia prasigyventi. Žurnalistu dirbantis Metas (akt. Casey Affleck) darbą "New York Times" dienraštyje iškeičia į karo žurnalistiką. Karo korespondentu įsidarbinęs Metas išvyksta į užsienį, o namie likusi jo žmona Nikolė (akt. Dakota Johnson) lieka rūpintis namais. Bet artimo žmogaus ilgesys priverčia Nikolę paslysti. Ji išduoda Metą su kitu ir taip įneša į santuoką abejones, pykčius, nepasitikėjimą. Reikalai dar labiau komplikuojasi, kai Nikolei diagnozuojamas kiaušidžių vėžys. Metas privalo grįžti namo rūpintis dukromis ir sergančia žmona. Finansinė našta vis labiau gula ant jauno vyro pečių. Čia į pagalbą atskuba poros geriausias draugas Deinas (akt. Jason Segel). Jis pasisiūlo kelioms savaitėms apsigyventi Nikolės ir Meto namuose ir pagelbėti prižiūrėti dukreles. Planavęs paviešėti tik porą savaičių, vyras netrukus supranta, kad su kiekviena diena jo pagalbos reikia vis labiau.

Dvylikametė Mina gyvena paprastą dvylikametės mergaitės gyvenimą: eina į mokyklą, ruošia pamokas, žaidžia su draugais ir kartais neklauso tėvelių. Tačiau vieną dieną jos ramus, paprastas ir mielas gyvenimas netikėtai pasikeičia, kai į jos namus atsikelia gyventi Dženė - Minės lyg ir sesuo, bet nevisai. Iš pradžių apsidžiaugusi, kad turės seserį, Mina netrukus pamato, kad Dženė nėra tokia, kokią ji įsivaizdavo, kokios norėjo ir apie kokią svajojo. Tačiau nutinka kai kas stebuklingo: Mina patenka į slaptą vietą, kurioje gaminami... sapnai! O išgirdus, kad įmanoma ne tik sukurti konkretų sapną bet kuriam žmogui, bet ir sapnuose priversti žmogų keistis, Minai galvon šauna neprilygstama mintis: pasitelkusi sapnų kūrimo galią ji pakeis Dženę!

1917 metų pavasarį Pirmasis pasaulinis karas visu pajėgumu drebina Europą. Britų karinė žvalgyba gauna informacijos, kad vienas jų batalionas žygiuoja tiesiai į priešo užimtą teritoriją. Kaip laiku perspėti 1600 karių, kas minutę artėjančių prie priešo linijos. Užduotis perduoti žinią apie pasalą patikima dviem jauniems eiliniams. Šofildas (George MacKay) ir Bleikas (George MacKay) privalo nepastebėti pereiti fronto liniją ir didžiulę priešo kontroliuojamą teritoriją. Tik sėkmės atveju šiaurės Prancūzijoje į pasalą žygiuojantys ginklo broliai liks gyvi. Neperdavus žinios, - jie žus visi iki vieno. Dviem šimtams apdovanojimų nominuota, šimtą trisdešimt keturis apdovanojimus, tarp jų ir tris Oskarus, laimėjusi karinė drama, kuri įtrauks ir nepaleis iki paskutinės minutės.

Angelų mieste siaučia nesugaunama bankų plėšikų gauja. Nepaisydami jokių pavojų, jie žaibiškai plėšia vieną banką po kito. Tuo tarpu Los Andželo policijos būrio vadas Nikas beviltiškai bando užbėgti už akių naujiems nusikaltimams. Kartu su savo būriu jis pasiryžta bet kokia kaina užkirsti kelią kitam apiplėšimui. Įžūli bankų plėšikų gauja ir dar įžūlesni farai. Gerard'as Butler'is kriminaliniame veiksmo filme – "Vagių irštva".

Rajanas (akt. Tarekas Boudali, jis taip pat ir šios komedijos režisierius) - jaunas ir geraširdis, bet be galo baikštus ir nerangus policininkas. Vaikinas beviltiškai įsimylėjęs kolegę Stefani (akt. Vanessa Guide). Eilinis apsilankymas pas gydytoją priverčia Rajaną permąstyti savo gyvenimą. Daktaras praneša, kad vaikinas sunkiai serga ir jam likę gyventi daugiausiai mėnuo. Jaunasis policininkas nusprendžia, kad visiškai neturi ką prarasti, ir nutaria iš gyvenimo išeiti su trenksmu, prieš tai tapęs visų laikų didvyriu... Originalus pavadinimas "30 Jours Max".

Tikrų įvykių įkvėptas filmas apie JAV laivyno pilotą Džesį Brauną (akt. Jonathan Majors). Vaikinas siekė svajonės dėdamas nežmoniškas pastangas ir demonstruodamas milžinišką valią ir užsispyrimą. Juk tuo metu pietinėse Amerikos valstijose juodaodžiams net nebuvo leidžiama mokytis ar važiuoti tuo pačiu autobusu, kuriuo važiuoja baltieji. Diskriminacijos šešėlis nesustabdė Džsesio ir jis tapo vienu geriausiu JAV laivyno pilotu. Įsiplieskus Korėjos karui Džesis su kovos draugais buvo paskirtas į karščiausią tašką. Jo būrio draugu tapo ir Tomas Hadneris, (akt. Glen Powell), kuris įprastame gyvenime toli gražu nelaikė juodaodžių sau lygiais. Tačiau labai greitai jo nusistatymai tampa nieko verti, nes mirties akivaizdoje vienintelis svarbus dalykas – pasitikėjimas būrio draugu.

Iš pasiturinčios šeimos kilęs Getsbis Velesas yra protingas, bet ekscentriškas jaunuolis. Drauge su savo mergina, žurnalistikos magistre, jis atvyksta į Niujorką. Čia Ešlė planuoja susitikimą dėl interviu su nepriklausomu kino režisieriumi Rolandu Polardu. Ji net neabejoja, kad šis straipsnis studentų laikraščiui bus tikra bomba. Nors interviu turi trukti tik valandą, mergina sužavi visą režisieriaus komandą ir jie pakviečia Ešlę į privačią naujojo filmo peržiūrą. Planai pavakaroti su mylimuoju Getsbiu susijaukia. Jaunuolis vienas vaikštinėja po vakarėjantį miestą ir sutinka seniai matytą draugą, kaip tyčia, filmuojantį vieną iš savo trumpo metražo juostų. Pasiskundęs, kad nepasirodė vienas iš aktorių, jis pasiūlo Getsbiui suvaidinti bučinio scenoje. Tokio sutapimo niekas negalėjo nuspėti, - Getsbio partnerė šioje scenoje - jo buvusios merginos jaunesnioji sesuo Čeinė. Po filmavimo jaunuolis palydi Čeinę namo. Čia jie kalbasi apie meilę Niujorkui ir abu pripažįsta, kad lietingomis dienomis šis miestas skleidžia ypatingą romantikos aurą. Vėliau jiedu aplanko Metropoliteno muziejų ir Čeinė prisipažįsta nuo seno mylinti Getsbį. Kol Getsbis leidžia laiką su vaikystės drauge, Ešlė dalyvauja kino verslo greitinėlės vakarėlye. Čia susipažįsta su žymiu aktoriumi Fransisku Vega. Vyriškį pakeri jaunos blondinės žavesys ir jis pasiūlo pavakarieniauti. Santykiai rutuliojasi nevaldomu greičiu ir Čeisė atsiduria aktoriaus miegamajame. Romantiškai šis pasimatymas nesibaigia, nes netikėtai pasirodo Fransisko mergina. Ešlei tenka sprukti pro užpakalines duris. Besibaigiant nakčiai, Ešlė ir Getsbis susitinka ir nutaria, kad kitą dieną leis drauge. Visi nesusipratimai turi likti užmarštį. Deja, pasivažinėjimas arklių traukiamu vežimaičiu Centriniame parke baigiasi išsiskyrimu. Po atviro pokalbio jaunuoliai įsitikina, kad neturi nieko bendro ir nori iš gyvenimo skirtingų dalykų. Negana to, Getsbis pareiškia, kad meta mokslus ir lieka Niujorke. Eidamas lietaus plaunamomis gatvėmis jis sutinka Čeinę. Tą akimirką jis supranta, kad likdamas Niujorke pasielgė teisingai.

Paryžius, XIX amžiaus pabaiga. Nors dvikovos oficialiai uždraustos, jos vis dar vyksta tamsiuose skersgatviuose. Daugeliui tai – vienintelis būdas nuplauti gėdą ir apginti savo vardą. Fechtavimo meistras Klemanas Lakazas desperatiškai bando atkalbėti savo sūnėną nuo lemtingos klaidos – nelygios kovos su patyrusiu ir negailestingu pulkininku Beršeru. Tačiau garbė nėra vien vyrų privilegija. Drąsioji feministė Mari iššūkį nusistovėjusioms normoms ir už savo orumą pasirengusi kovoti ne mažiau aršiai.

Derlinguose slėniuose, nusidriekusiuose galingųjų Himalajų kalnų papėdėje, gyvena našlaitis vardu Balmanis. Vieną naktį Balmanis netyčia pamato, kaip brakonieriai nušauna tigrę, o jos jauniklį įmeta į narvą, tikėdamiesi pelningai parduoti. Negalėdamas tiesiog stovėti ir nieko nedaryti, berniukas, prisidengęs nakties tamsa, išvaduoja tigriuką iš nelaisvės. Jis puikiai žino, kad dabar, brakonieriams lipant ant kulnų, jam nebelieka kitos išeities, tik keliauti į vienuolyną dar žinomą "Tigro lizdo" vardu, įsikūrusį aukštai kalnuose, kuriame gyvenantys vienuoliai saugo, globoja ir rūpinasi nykstančiais galingaisiais tigrais. Originalus pavadinimas "Ta'Igara: An Adventure In The Himalayas".

Studentė Irena atvyksta į pasaulio mados sostinę - Milaną. Kad galėtų pragyventi studijuodama universitete ji įsidarbina prestižiniame mados žurnale. Nuo tos akimirkos jos gyvenimas pasikeičia neatpažįstamai. Sekdama Milano naujausiomis srovėmis, kai italų mada įsitvirtino visame pasaulyje, ji pamažu tampa vis svarbesnė figūra drabužių dizainerių pasaulyje. Komiškas serialas – "Pagaminta Italijoje".

Ypatingas katinas gali įvykdyti bet kokią misiją, nes yra be galo sumanus agentas. Deja, šalia talento yra ir siaubingas užsispyrimas, verčiantis priešintis valdžios nurodymams. Vadai nusprendžia nebesitaikstyti su tokiu pavaldinio elgesiu, todėl išsiunčia katinėlį į plaukiojančią laboratoriją su nuobodžia, bet labai svarbia misija. Pasirodo, katinas ten atvyksta pačiu laiku! Ar jis spės sustabdyti nenaudėlius, ketinančius sunaikinti daugybę Žemės gyvūnų? Originalus pavadinimas "Spycies".

Vera - paauglė mergina iš paprastos šeimos. Ji ne savo noru patenka į mokyklą, kurioje mokosi tik turtingų tėvų vaikai. Čia mokosi ir Romanas, mokyklos įkūrėjo sūnus. Tarp Romano ir Veros iškart įsižiebia kibirkštis. Galiausiai jie pajunta abipusę simpatiją bei suartėja per bendrą aistrą muzikai. Tačiau Romanas nenutuokia, jog Vera priversta jį šnipinėti, kad išgelbėtų savo jaunesnįjį brolį iš kolonijos. Mokykla įtariama prekyba narkotikais. Policija nori demaskuoti nusikaltėlius, todėl įtraukia Verą į abiturientų klasę kaip savo "šnipę". Kriminalinis draminis serialas - "Naujokė".

p.d: Televizijos eterį užkariauja intelektualumu ir sarkastiškais pasisakymais garsėjantis Andrius Tapinas. Visiems gerai žinomas žurnalistas, laidų vedėjas ir rašytojas žiūrovus džiugins daug dėmesio susilaukusiu flagmanu. Kiekvienas kviečiamas įsitraukti į intelektualios satyros vakarus, kurių metu įvairiausiais kampais bus apžvelgi kasdieniai įvykiai, rimtos problemos ir visiems rūpimos aktualijos. Žinomi svečiai, įdomiausios diskusijos ir įžvalgos su gyva auditorija filmuojamoje laidoje "Laikykitės ten su Andriumi Tapinu"!

Istorija apie jauną detektyvę, kuri atvyksta į tikrą policijos pragarą. Čia jai tenka įrodyti, jog naujoji karta gali pakeisti sistemą iš vidaus ir priminti, kad policija turi gerbti piliečius ir suteikti saugumą. Nuovadoje ji susipažįsta su uždaru bei arogantišku senbuviu. Iš pradžių tarp jų vyrauja nesantaika, tačiau dirbdami kartu sudėtingose bylose jie palaipsniui pradeda geriau suprasti vienas kitą. Detektyvinis serialas - "Tyrėjų porelė".

Tėvų namai – vienintelis dalykas, kuris sieja šias tris visiškai skirtingas seseris. Garsi mados dizainerė, mokytoja bei buvusi boksininkė jau daugelį metų nebendravo tarpusavyje ir būtų likusios laimingos gyvendamos atskirai. Tačiau karas jas vėl suvedė po vienu stogu. Seserys turi išsiaiškinti santykius ne tik tarpusavyje, bet ir su buvusiais, dabartiniais ir būsimais mylimaisiais. Ukrainiečių humoro serialas - "Seserys".

Du privatūs detektyvai nežinodami vienas apie kito egzistavimą imasi tirti garsaus verslininko dukters pagrobimą. Andrėjus Vorobjovas pasižymi aštriu protu ir labiau žinomas dėl savo nestandartinių, gudrių sprendimų nei dėl kovinių pasiekimų. Brutalusis Piotras Voroncovas, priešingai, turi karinį išsilavinimą, yra įpratęs prie disciplinos, o savo jėga ir atkaklumu gali gauti itin slaptos informacijos. Tirdami painią bylą detektyvai sužino apie seifą, kuriame slepiasi gangsterio turtai su 50 milijonų dolerių! Tačiau norint pasiekti pinigus, prisiekusiems varžovams ir priešams teks tapti komanda. Komiškas detektyvinis serialas - "Varnas ir žvirblis".

Nusipelnęs detektyvas Stepanas išėjęs į pensiją svajojo apie ramų gyvenimą, bet jo planus staigiai pakeitė Rusijos įsiveržimas į Ukrainą. Po metų tarnybos fronte ir sunkios traumos Stepanas grįžta namo, tikėdamasis pailsėti. Tačiau jo dukra, teismo medicinos ekspertė, prašo tėvo pagalbos ištirti sudėtingą žmogžudystę. Netikėtai Stepanas sužino, kad naujasis jaunas partneris yra jo būsimas žentas. Po tokios pažinties konfliktas tarp patyrusio detektyvo ir ambicingo jauno tyrėjo tampa nevaldomas. Įtraukiantis detektyvinis serialas - "Tėvas".

Fredas gabus žurnalistas, dėl savo bohemiško gyvenimo būdo nuolat įsiveliantis į įvairiausius nesusipratimus bei nuotykius. Šarlotė – viena įtakingiausių ir galingiausių moterų pasaulyje: protinga, stilinga ir graži. Jie neturi absoliučiai nieko bendro, išskyrus tai, kad kažkada Fredas ją buvo vaikiškai įsimylėjęs. Dabar Šarlotė ruošiasi kandidatuoti į prezidentus, tad ji pasamdo Fredą kaip savo kalbų rašytoją. Tarp jų vėl įsiplieskia kibirkštys. Jie niekada nebus kartu, nors jis turi viltį. Seth Rogen'as ir Charlize Theron romantinėje komedijoje – "Be šansų".

Stefanės gyvenimas pasikeitė tą dieną, kai ji susipažino su išskirtine asmenybe: Emile. Stefanė nuo pat pirmojo susitikimo susižavi elegantiška, nuostabiai gražia ir paslaptinga moterimi – tokia, kokia norėtų būti ir ji pati. Jos netrunka tapti geriausiomis draugėmis. Tačiau vieną dieną, netikėto skambučio metu paprašiusi "nedidelės paslaugos", Emilė pradingsta. be pėdsakų. Nei jos vyrui, nei į paieškas įsijungusiai policijai nepavyksta aptikti nė menkiausios užuominos. Desperatiškai ieškodama bent kokio nors siūlo galo, Stefanė pradeda domėtis Emilės praeitimi ir pamažu prieš jos akis ima skleistis visiškai kitoks nuostabiosios draugės paveikslas. Visi turi paslapčių, kurių geriau niekam neatskleisti. Anna Kendrick mistiniame trileryje – "Nedidelė paslauga".

Сотрудники полиции участвуют во всех особо важных делах – спасении заложников и переговорах с террористами, эвакуации жителей и обезвреживании бомб, охоте на серийного убийцу и даже решении семейных конфликтов. В арсенале у участников ГСР (группы стратегического реагирования) не только высокотехнологичное оружие, но еще и быстрый ум, интуиция и… багаж собственных проблем и травм, которые часто влияют на их работу.

Группа Один пытается найти стрелка, который ранил Эда. Им оказался муж женщины-военной, которая находится под давлением группы, занимающейся контрабандой наркотиков через военные каналы из Афганистана. Джулс и Сэм идут на рискованный шаг, чтобы захватить преступника. После этого доктор Тот, позволяет Группе Один остаться в прежнем составе, но на испытательный срок.

Талантливый криминалист Борис Крылов попадает вместе с отцом в автомобильную аварию. Отец погибает на месте, а Крылов покидает больницу в инвалидном кресле. Он уверен, что авария была подстроена и убийство отца, известного хирурга, было спланировано. Чтобы провести собственное расследование, Крылов соглашается вернуться к работе в полиции….

Талантливый криминалист Борис Крылов попадает вместе с отцом в автомобильную аварию. Отец погибает на месте, а Крылов покидает больницу в инвалидном кресле. Он уверен, что авария была подстроена и убийство отца, известного хирурга, было спланировано. Чтобы провести собственное расследование, Крылов соглашается вернуться к работе в полиции….

Расследование в больнице не продвигается, улик у Крылова нет. Голубев рассказывает Алеше, что он его кровный отец. Лариса лжет Крылову по непонятным причинам. На рассвете в парке обнаруживают тело обеспеченной женщины. Она была известна в городе, как жестокая и несправедливая руководительница, увольнявшая людей за малейшие недочеты. Поэтому подозреваемых много.

Борис выясняет, что нападение на Ларису — инсценировка. Но бывшая жена запутывает мужчину. Борис признается Анне в любви, но ей не до романтики: проблемы с сыном усугубляются, Алеша обвиняет мать в том, что она скрыла правду об отце. В убийстве женщины в парке подозревают ее многочисленных ухажеров. Но Крылову удается установить реальную цепь событий.

Крылов узнает, что погиб один из подозреваемых в деле об аварии. Кто-то считает эксперта серьезным врагом. Анна в шоке от новости о том, что сын связался с Голубевым. В безлюдной части города обнаружено тело мужчины в женском облачении. Погибший — трансвестит, завсегдатай престижного клуба для лиц нетрадиционной ориентации. Когда Крылов начал копаться в деле, убили еще одного постоянного посетителя клуба.

Анна держит Крылова на дистанции, для нее главной проблемой становится отваживание Голубева от сына. Воскресенская отваживается встретиться с Голубевым, когда Алеша сбегает из дома, но сама пропадает. Борис узнает, как его обманывала Лариса. Также он обнаруживает мафиозный след в фармацевтической отрасли, начинает постепенно докапываться до того, почему погиб отец.

Голубев нападает на Анну, связывает, запирает в своем жилище. Алеша находится там же, но ни о чем не подозревает. Голубев уверен, что обрел семью, но тут к нему в гости заявляется Крылов, желающий вызволить Воскресенскую. Голубев радушно принимает гостя, затем наносит оглушающий удар. Когда Алеша спускается в подвал, то видит там скованного человека, который говорит, что он отец психически больного Голубева. До мальчика доходит, что он, как и мама, пленник. Анна просит сына бежать. Оказывается, 10 лет назад Голубев изнасиловал Воскресенскую.

Сериал рассказывает о работе специального подразделения полиции, занимающегося проблемами домашнего насилия. Четыре главные героини помогают женщинам, детям и даже мужчинам, страдающим от тирании, побоев, унижений и других способов угнетения со стороны близких людей. Героини сериала будут попадать в сложные и опасные ситуации, спасая жизни и восстанавливая справедливость. Каждая женщина из этой четверки тоже прошла через насилие: у каждой – своя история, скелет в шкафу и сильная мотивация заниматься именно этим делом.

Kritikų pripažintas ir "Emmy" apdovanojimui nominuotas šou grįžta naujam sezonui. Šiame sezone - naujos istorijos apie žmones, kurie įkyriai kaupia daiktus, o jų kolekcionavimas užvaldo jų šeimas ir gyvenimus. Nesvarbu, ar jiems gresia išsikraustymas, skyrybos, ar nutrūkę santykiai, visiems kaupikams labai reikia pagalbos.

Žvilgsnis į žmones ir įrangą, atsakingus už Tedo Stivenso oro uosto veiklą ir priežiūrą. Dėl oro uosto vietos ir oro sąlygų jie susiduria su daugybe unikalių iššūkių. Šioje milžiniškoje operacijoje dalyvauja daugybė komandų, įskaitant oro eismo ir antžeminius dispečerius, elektrikus, mechanikus, technikus, policiją, ugniagesius, kilimo ir tūpimo takų priežiūrą ir valymą, orlaivių techninę priežiūrą, oro linijų įgulas ir atstovus, ledo tako ir vandens pakilimo bei nusileidimo komandas ir daugybę kitų svarbių žmonių, kurie rūpinasi, kad visa ši operacija būtų saugi ir veiksminga.
Tikros ir nepagražintos istorijos tiesiai iš pareigūnų eikpažų. Jungtinių Amerikos Valstijų kriminalinio pasaulio kasdienybė, užfiksuota dokumentiniame seriale.

Ukrainos televizijos kanalo "Novyi Kanal" tiriamasis realybės šou, kurio metu žurnalistai dirbo tikrus darbus užsienyje, siekdami atskleisti darbo realijas įvairiose šalyse. Seriale nagrinėjamos tokios temos kaip atlyginimai, gyvenimo sąlygos ir darbo paieška įvairiose šalyse.

Iki ašarų prajuokinantis legendinis serialas apie nevykėlių klasę policijos akademijoje, kuri kiekvieną dieną susiduria su pavojais, kuriems jie nėra pasiruošę...

Realybės šou, kuriame susipažinsite su Goldų šeima. Būdami didžiausio Detroito lombardo savininkai, jie pirko ir pardavinėjo daiktus, kokių net neįsivaizduojate. Kiekviena diena kelia naujų pavojų, nes Goldų šeima dirba viename iš pavojingiausių miestų Amerikoje. Juos supa 50 000 kv. metrų grynųjų pinigų ir prekių.
LIetuviški TV kanalai tiesiogiai internetu bet kokiame įrenginyje. Išbandyk Go3.

Negavę bilietų į skrydį, du skubantys nepažįstamieji sumano gudrybę - kartu išsinuomoti mažą lėktuvėlį. Planas pavyksta. Jiedviem skrendant virš vaizdingų kalnų panoramų, lėktuvas staiga sminga žemyn. Pilotas žūva, o abu keleiviai išsigelbėja. Jie privalės rasti bendrą kalbą tam, kad išliktų gyvi snieguotame ir atšiauriame kraštovaizdyje. Vaidina Beau Bridgesas, Idris Elba, Kate Winslet. Originalus pavadinimas "The Mountain Between Us".

Amerikiečių antiteroristinės grupuotės narys Džei Džei (akt. Ethan Green Hawke) gauna nepaprastą užduotį. Dislokuotas Romoje, jis turi užkirsti kelią teroristiniams išpuoliams Vatikane. Vienas po kito sprogdinami Romos istoriniai paminklai ir tai kelia nemažą sumaištį visoje šalyje. Siekdamas atskleisti, kas sėja paniką šventojo sosto prieigose, Džei Džei ieško ir savo brolio dvynio. Anarchistas, poliniu kaliniu buvęs jo brolis jau daug metų yra pradingęs be žinios. Tačiau viltis jį sutikti gyvą ir sveiką neblėsta. Lenktynės su laiku ir blogį sėjančiais ekstremalais teroristais prasideda.
Kelios komandos, lenktyniaudamos aplink pasaulį dėl 1 000 000 JAV dolerių prizo, neaplenkia ir nuostabių vietų.

Kiekvieną dieną JAV pagalbos tarnybos priima tūkstančius skambučių iš nelaimės ištiktų ir pagalbos reikalaujančių asmenų. Tokiais atvejais į pagalbą skuba policija, paramedikai ar ugniagesiai gelbėtojai. Seriale visų šių gelbėjimo tarnybų ir jų darbuotojų kasdienis gyvenimas. Skubios tarnybos operatorius Ebė ne tik siunčia pagalbą, bet ir dažnai dirba kaip psichologas, norėdamas paguosti nelaimės ištiktus žmones. Ebės gyvenimas nėra lengvas - ji prižiūri Alzheimerio liga sergančią motiną. Policijos pareigūnės Atėnės šeima subyra, nes jos vyras prisipažino esąs gėjus. Gaisrinėje dirba visa komanda - kapitonas Bobis, kurio praeityje yra tamsi paslaptis, jis buvęs alkoholikas ir narkomanas. Bobio pavaldiniai Evansas ir Hovis turi savų bėdų. Seriale apžvelgiamas ne tik užimtas gelbėtojų gyvenimas, bet ir jų tarpusavio santykiai bei asmeninio gyvenimo posūkiai.

Lietuva per pastaruosius 100 metų išgyveno daug dramatiškų istorinių lūžių kuriuos lydėjo informacija, kuria buvo stengiamasi formuoti viešąją nuomonę. Valstybės viduje ar išorėje. Lietuvoje per šiuos metus ne kartą buvo bandoma varžyti žiniasklaidos laisvę. Koks buvo propagandos vaidmuo, lemiamų istorinių įvykių eigoje? Kodėl labai svarbu įvertinti informacinį foną nagrinėjant Lietuvos istoriją? Kaip išugdyti dabartinės kartos gebėjimą savarankiškai ir kritiškai vertinti informaciją? Koks geriausias ginklas prieš propagandą?

Kasdienė populiari naujienų laida, pateikianti svarbiausią ir aktualiausią informaciją iš Lietuvos ir pasaulio. Laidoje – faktai ir komentarai, tiesioginiai reportažai iš įvykių vietų bei išsamios aktualių temų apžvalgos.

p.t: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball‌
p.d: Penny wants to ask Gumball to the Elmore Jr High Prom, but when Gumball's expectations for an extra romantic and extra complicated gesture become way more than Penny can handle, Penny must find a way to deliver.

The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird….

Follow the daily adventures of a 10-year-old boy named Clarence, and his two best friends Sumo and Jeff. Clarence lives with his mother Mary and her boyfriend Chad in the fictional town of Aberdale, and he is optimistic, curious, honest and quirky boy, who sees the best in everyone and gets himself in a variety of funny situations and everyday problems, which he solves with lots of imagination and with the help from his friends.

Total DramaRama is canadian animated comedy series, spin-off of Total Drama, all characters are already well-known and loved by the audience. This time Duncan, Gwen, Courtney, Izzy, Noah, Bridgette and the rest find themselves in the past as kids and their adventures take place in kindergarten. The strict Chef Hatchet is there to keep his eye on them. Any harmless idea of the kids turns out to be a total disaster, they are irrepressible in producing new ideas on how to have fun. the kids are discussing every single decision and plan in front of the cameras just like their adult versions, being a part of a reality show.

CNN Newroom provides the most up to date news as it breaks and is the longest running show on the channel, airing twice a day Monday to Friday and throughout the day over the weekends. CNN has developed a lot since its founding in 1980 by American media proprietor Ted Turner as a 24 hour cable news channel. As an organisation, CNN have won multiple awards, including a network-record six news & documentary Emmy Awards in 2018.

Marketplace Asia on CNN offers unique access to the latest Asian market information, with a look at latest events and developments that impact its business world. Follow the top business stories that influence and shape the Asian continent. Have a look at the interviews with outstanding figures of business and industry and reveal the economic trends in various regions of Asia to get to know the continent's key sectors and corporations.

Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

Each episode of Extreme Engineering discussed some major construction project, some of them are projects that have already been completed like Hong Kong's airport. Others talked abount projects that are currently under construction like Tuneling Under the Alps. And some episodes talked about more futuristic projects that may never be done like the Transatlantic Tunnel. Most episodes finished by examining some sort of disaster scenario which could threaten or ruin the project that was being examined.

As the days get shorter and colder, and snow is visible on the highest peaks, the builders frantically race to get their homes sealed in. Chuck Gerwig suffered a huge blow earlier in the summer with the loss of his righthand man, and now his ten hour days are up to twelve and its starting to show. Barely keeping in front of his subcontractors, one small mistake could mean not finishing. In Chicken, Jim Wagner's organizational luck has just run out. His flooring is four bundles short. So, with everything shutting down for the winter in a week, he's got to decide whether or not to make the half day journey to the lumberyard, which is no guarantee, or finish the roof before snow flies. Finally, at remote Quiet Lake, Lee Raymond's son "high speed, no grease" Aaron, is scrambling to get the roofing on before the snow. But the constant rain mixed with Aaron's speed has created a very slick situation and Aaron just can't hold on.

Winter has arrived and the race is over. It's time for each of our builders to come to terms with their end games as they pack up and head home for the season. To say this year has been a challenge would be an understatement. From lakes, to glaciers, to areas savaged by fire, nothing was immune from Alaska's hostile nature. Whether that came in the form of brutal weather, extreme fatigue, or even death, it had to be endured and overcome. And although the men, their homes and the sites were vastly different, they all can lay claim to the same victory in surviving Alaska's wrath. Now is the time to shutter in, rest, and take stock in what matters for in just a few short months the season will change again and usher in a new chapter of Building Alaska.

Reality series showing American house hunters who are considering joining the tiny-house revolution where people are choosing to live in smaller homes - often less than 55 square metres -and praising their benefits. In this property series realtors present three petite houses to prospective buyers. Some of the homes would be used as permanent residences whilst others could be a retreat to escape to. There are various reasons for the trend for tiny-living; some people are doing it for financial reasons, others are trying to live more ecologically and some yearn for a simpler lifestyle. When the potential tiny-homeowners are faced with the practical limitations of the properties on offer will they take the plunge and embrace the joys of tiny living? Or will they change their minds for more spacious accommodation?

Wildebeest and Zebra - Africa's most famous drifters. Hundreds of thousands of zebra live together in the Serengeti. Their distinctive eye-catching stripes are as unique as fingerprints and even within the largest of gatherings no two zebra will be found with exactly the same stripes. Turtles that make epic journeys to reproduce. The most abundant sea turtle in the world, Olive Ridleys' have extraordinary nesting habits. These small turtles migrate massive distances between their oceanic feeding grounds and the shores that draw them back to mate, and then to nest. Sooty Tern - Sea birds that don't come to land for years. Like the turtle, once it has left land for the first time, a young Sooty Tern may not go back for years, spending all its time in the ocean skies until it is time for it to breed. Soaring on outstretched wings, these elegant seabirds feed almost entirely on the fish driven to the surface by the hunters below. Australian Pelicans - Water birds that follow ephemeral rivers. Pelicans – these quirky, comical, big billed birds are usually thought of as spending all their time around coasts and harbors. They are widespread in Australia's lakes, rivers, billabongs and estuaries – or other waterway with enough food for their fish-loving lifestyle. The whales and whale sharks that roam the great oceans. Some of the greatest migratory animals on earth are those that live in its waters and traverse its great oceans. From baleen whales that travel from the nutrient rich polar waters and the whale sharks whose migrations we barely understand.

The targeting Archer fish. Just below the surface of the water is one of nature's most precise miniature hunters – the fabulous Archer fish. Able to shoot down their prey with targeted jet propelled water darts the archer fish is bulls-eye accurate. The ambushing Portia. A mere centimeter in length, the Portia spider is one of nature's most capable and intelligent hunters. A formidable serial killer of other spiders, Portia's are fast to learn and quick to adapt. The harpooning cone shell. In an ocean full of fast moving and agile fish, those that hunt them need sure fire methods of capture. So it is perhaps surprising that one of their most deadly adversaries, is a very slow moving snail. Weapon swinging Bolas Spiders. As the day comes to and darkness sets in, one of the world's most deceptive hunters begins her nightly rituals. Dangling from the silken trapeze line she has just laid the female Bolas Spider spins a short silken thread punctuated with tiny globules and ending in one huge sticky silken bolas. Slave Making Ants. Running over almost every corner of the earth are millions and millions of tiny worker ants. Yet for some ant species, most of the workers are not their own blood. These are the slave makers trap laying Ant Lions. Throughout the sandy soils that blanket the earth there are hundreds of species of ants making a living on the land they find themselves. Yet there is one insect whose larvae makes a living on them – the one and a half centimeter, cunning, powerful, ferocious and often inconspicuous Ant lion Parasitic Pompilid wasps In the dunes of the Namib Desert is a little wasp that seeks out a very certain type of prey. Pompilid wasps, also known as spider wasps are named after the food they seek, and they are extremely good at seeking it.…which is the top of the micro predators?

Tentacles follows Dr. Jennifer Mather as she leads a team of renowned scientists to the beautiful Caribbean island of Bonaire. Their mission is to prove a controversial theory: reef squid speak to each other with a complex language they paint on their skin. The episode features the bizarre courtship and never-before-filmed egg-laying rituals of reef squid. Travel to the Pacific Northwest for an encounter with the world's largest Octopus. You'll also witness the fascinating hunting technique of the cuttlefish.

Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

Deserts are dry. Deserts are extreme. True deserts get less than 18 cm of rain per year. True deserts have very few plants. Semi-desert habitats have enough rainfall to support more plant and animal life. Either way, deserts are not easy places for animals to live. Desert animals have evolved to handle the desert's heat and lack of water. They have adapted their bodies and behaviors to the desert climate. Most can survive on small amounts of water and many get all of their water from their food. Some drink maybe once a week and travel considerable distances to find isolated waterholes and springs. Large animals seek shade during the hottest part of the day. Some animals dig a hollow depression into the ground and lie in the cooler soil while others are nocturnal. Many reptiles and other animals protect themselves from the extreme temperature by spending their time in burrows. The scorpion is one of the most ancient creatures on earth, in existence since life first crawled out of the sea. One look and you can see why they're born survivors. Not only are their bodies armoured against the desert heat - and other predators - but all scorpions have pincers at the front and a poisonous sting at the end of their tail. Rattlesnakes can be two meters long. They're fast, tough and with a deadly venom, making them one of the most dangerous snakes in the world. But nobody seems to have told the Roadrunner, who regard rattlesnakes as quite suitable prey.

These are Nature's own Battletanks, and (with the exception of the Indian Elephant), all endemic to the African continent. The African Savannah is the stage for thousands of battles every day. How do elephants, these large, cumbersome creatures survive and even prosper on a diet that even the strictest vegetarian would pass on! Well for one thing, most other animals get out of their way. But lions and hyenas are not always so easily moved – they prey on young, sick and old elephants in particular. This seemingly gentle giant has been revealed to have a darker side in the last few years too. They may survive on just plant life, but that doesn't mean they don't like a fight – to the death. Elephants have been observed attacking and killing Rhinos in the last 20 years. It's a savage clash. Meanwhile, the Rhino, a tough looking customer if ever there was one, is an endangered species. When the great herds go on the search for food, predators go on the hunt for them. If ever there was an animal that seems destined to survive, it's the Rhino, which has been around for over 6 million years. But it too has an enemy: mankind – the deadliest foe of all. Then there's the hippopotamus. An adult hippo is a huge, aggressive animal, and even the largest crocodiles tend to stay away from it. However, when baby hippos stray from their mothers, then crocodiles, lions and hyenas will have a go if they can get away without being attacked themselves by adults in the baby hippo's herd. That's why baby hippos must stay close to Mum.

How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity….

February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! - No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people - from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I simply cannot wait for more!

In the series pilot, host Jonathan Bird travels to the Bahamas, where, in the past few years, diver interactions with Tiger sharks have become up close and personal. These large and dangerous animals are not only being hand-fed, but actually handled by divers. Jonathan learns how to flip a Tiger shark from experienced shark handlers. Next, Jonathan joins world-renown cave explorer Brian Kakuk to investigate the Crystal Cave of Abaco, Bahamas…considered the most highly-ornamented underwater cave in the world! The formations in this cave are simply stunning, and incredibly unique.

Jonathan travels to Iceland to investigate a giant crack in the ground filled with frigid runoff from melting glaciers. It's rumored to be the clearest water in the world. But to find out, Jonathan has to brave some very cold water. Next, he heads down to sunny Florida, not to dive a coral reef or a spectacular shipwreck, but to dive in shallow, murky water under a busy bridge. This secret spot is home to some of the ocean's most remarkable, and weird, animals.

Mankind has been flying for over a century. As early as the 1500s Leonardo da Vinci tried to build a flying machine. Drawing inspiration from birds he gave it wings. Unfortunately, his "Ornithopter" didn't work, and indeed, the airplanes of today do not have flapping wings! We also tried it with balloons. Huge 245-metre long airships that needed the guts of between 80,000 to 200,000 cows! But, it was the kite that became the forerunner of the flying machine. A kite made by the now famous Wright brothers. The two brothers were bicycle repairmen, which convinced them that a flying machine could be highly unstable and yet controllable, such as with bicycles. They built their kites as strong as their bicycle frames and used bicycle parts to test their workings. The early Wright planes could manage no more than 65 km/h. Nowadays, a commercial plane can top 800 km/h. What is it that make our current planes fly 12 times faster? Well, one British Royal Air pilot, Frank Whittle, remembered his school experiments with the 'Aeolipile', a piece of ancient Greek engineering. This pilot argued that we could fly faster - if we'd fly higher - because there is less air resistance at high altitudes. The future of aviation has lead to Airbus's A380, the largest passenger plane in the world as well as the scramjet built by NASA. So what will be the next quirky discovery for flight?

Cooling is more than a luxury. Nowadays it is a necessity. Without refrigerated shipping and stocking, fresh food wouldn't reach our supermarket so easily. Can you imagine living without it? Before the invention of the refrigerator, icehouses were used to provide cool storage for most of the year. To cool our food and beverages, blocks of ice were simply cut out of frozen lakes and shipped to far and beyond. The so-called "ice-industry" came to its end when, in the late 1900s, our waters became too polluted to serve as a cool preserving agent. Air-conditioning, on the other hand, was actually invented to control the humidity that was ruining the paper of printing offices, rather than the technology being used to cool you off. The quirky part is, you can't create cold; you can only "move" temperature form one place to another. The first one to find a technology that cooled the inside of a box - the forefather of the refrigerator - was a medical doctor. In fact, he thought he was building a machine to cure malaria. And yet it took over a century after that, before people started using refrigerators, because refrigerators were thought to be dangerous. And they had a point! For a few decades, the refrigerator was something of a killer machine (literally) as they omitted toxic gases that poisoned people… Even Einstein got worried and developed a cooling-machine. And when refrigerators stopped killing people, scientists discovered that refrigerants were harming the environment. All sorts of chemicals have passed through our refrigerator coils, to be discarded… but perhaps we have a new solution: cooling with the vibrations of sound. That does sound cool.

Pasakojimas apie Amerikos ikoną bei pasaulinio garso imtynininką Hulką Hoganą. Jis turėjo viską: gerbėjus, pinigų, mylinčią šeimą, netgi savo televizijos laidą... bet žiniasklaidai nutekėjęs garsusis sekso įrašas amžiams pakeitė jo gyvenimą. Šis filmas atskleidžia skandalą, kuris vystėsi už ringo, žmogaus kovą su savo paties legenda bei lemtingą kovą už teisę į privatumą.
Buvusio NFL gynėjo Erico Naposki ryšis su žmogžudystės byla meilės trikampio fone kelia klausimų dėl jo kaltės bei galimo galvos traumų poveikio.

Per savo vestuvių metines paslaptingai dingsta Mike'as Williamsas. Atrodo, kad jis galėjo tapti aligatorių grobiu, tačiau pirmasis įspūdis gali būti apgaulingas. Paslaptį atskleidžia lemtingas atradimas bylos tyrime.

Kolorado valstijoje dingsta tipinė priemiesčių mama Paige Birgfeld ir miestelio gyvenimas panyra į įtampą. Pareigūnai ieško įkalčių ir padaro šokiruojantį atradimą, kad atsidavusi mama gyveno slaptą dvigubą gyvenimą.

Kaimo gyventojai priversti susidurti su slepiamu praeities įvykiu ir veja bendrus demonus, o Gamašas daro proveržį ir supranta, kad Marko žudikas turėjo labai asmeninį motyvą.

Gamašo jubiliejaus šventę viešbutyje "Manoir Belleforet" nutraukia rastas kūnas; Gamašas ir jo komanda tiria bylą, kurioje daugiausia dėmesio skiriama viešbučio savininkams - disfunkcinei Morou šeimai.

As a nit pandemic sweeps the school, Julia finds herself accused of triggering a second wave. Ostracised by the other mums, Julia needs to find a way back into their good books, so she throws a nit treatment party that brings everyone's drama (and headlice) into her home. The party reveals that Anne has some big news, Meg is facing a crisis and Kevin has committed a terrible crime of passion. As Amanda super-spreads the gossip, Liz waits for news about a career move - will she beat that 17-year-old to a job in the local shoe shop?

The mums (and dad) join the merry go round of secondary school open days as they face the choice of where to send their kids at 11. Julia panics about which catchment area she lives in and even considers a fake religious conversion to beat the system. As Kevin's divorce progresses, Liz helps him navigate the shark pool of lawyers and makes a worrying discovery about her own situation along the way. Meanwhile, queen bee Amanda struggles with playing second fiddle to Meg's illness.

British comedy series following a group of middle-class mothers as they navigate parenthood. Written by Sharon Horgan and Graham Linehan, the series showcases the pragmatic aspects of motherhood, far from the romanticised portrayal often depicting life as a parent. The group, lead by Amanda, a shallow and perfunctory character, are competitively caring, helping each other with their maternal headaches but each wants to prove they are coping effortlessly. A eclectic bunch, they have very different perspectives on how to raise a child. The series features performances from Anna Maxwell Martin, Lucy Punch, Diane Morgan and Paul Ready.

It's time for the Year 6 school trip, and Julia, Liz and Meg find themselves on the coach journey from hell with humourless school secretary Mrs Lamb and clueless teaching assistant Ms Vaughn. It all kicks off when a boy banned for bad behaviour is allowed on the coach along with his mother Ashley, and Liz decides to play the hero. Meanwhile, Kevin takes his driving test, and Amanda pivots her lifestyle brand Hygge Tygge online. She manages to persuade Kevin to help pack up the shop - with unimaginable consequences.

Delve into the hearts and minds of six friends living in New York City as they explore the anxieties and absurdities of true adulthood. This smart, sophisticated series offers a hilarious take on dating and working in the big city. As Rachel, Monica, Phoebe, Joey, Chandler and Ross realize, the search for happiness often seems to turn up more questions than answers. But while they look within for fulfillment, they also look out for one another during this exciting time when everything seems possible – as long as they've got Friends.

At Monica's Halloween party, Phoebe meets the friendly fiancé, Eric (Sean Penn), of her flighty twin, Ursula. Phoebe becomes alarmed when she learns that her sister has misrepresented herself to the trusting guy - and Phoebe finds herself attracted to him as well. Monica comes disguised as Catwoman and wonders if she could defeat Phoebe's Supergirl character. Chandler arrives as a pink bunny and mistakes Ross' giant "Spudnik" costume for something found on a sidewalk. Also, Rachel gives away all the candy and guiltily resorts to writing checks for the trick-or-treaters.

Ross is happy to learn that pregnant Rachel wants to find her own apartment. He suggests a vacancy in his building but later discovers that the elderly occupant is not dead yet, as he had assumed. Ross gets some tough competition from Rachel's roommate, Joey, who creates a nursery in their apartment to persuade her to stay. Meanwhile, Phoebe is ecstatic when Eric (Sean Penn) ends his relationship with her twin sister, Ursula, and chooses Phoebe instead. Monica becomes agitated when she suspects that her new maid is stealing her jeans, among other things.

Rachel nervously tells her short-tempered father, Dr. Leonard Green, that she is pregnant with Ross' baby. Dr. Green then confronts Ross in his apartment, just as Ross is beginning to snuggle up with his new girlfriend, Mona. Meanwhile, Monica feels guilty for denying Chandler a real bachelor party, so she arranges to have a stripper perform at a belated party for him and his friends. Unfortunately, the woman that arrives is definitely not what Monica ordered.

In this Thanksgiving episode, special guest star Brad Pitt plays Will, Monica's high school friend who was the only student fatter than Monica was. She invites him to Thanksgiving dinner with the gang, unaware that he isn't exactly fond of Rachel. Meanwhile, Chandler and Phoebe pretend to be enthralled with a televised football game in order to avoid helping Monica in the kitchen. And Joey vows to devour the entire turkey single-handedly.

Earl Hickey's life has been full of poor choices and mistakes, and upon discovering that he is the holder of a winning lottery ticket, Earl is hit by a car and the ticket blows out of his hand as he lies unconscious in the street. While recovering in the hospital and watching television, Earl has a karmic epiphany, thanks to Carson Daly, who attributes his success to doing good for others. A light bulb goes on in Earl's dim head, and he sets out to right every wrong he has done. He will turn his good fortune into a life changing event, as he sets out to right all the wrongs from his past. Despite his seemingly limited intelligence, he is oddly effective and has a voice and style of his own.

The focus is on three families who are related: Jay and his young wife Gloria, with their son Manny. Claire, the daughter of Jay from a previous marriage, and her family; husband, Phil, and children, Hayley, Alex, and Luke. Then the third family, which compromises of Mitchell, Jay's other son and Claire's brother, and his family; Cameron, his husband, and their adopted child, Lily. All members of this diverse family have their own character quirks, which combine to create hilarious scenarios around family life. The show first aired in 2009, and has watched the characters grow through the years, addressing all the dramas that come with this. It does so in a light-hearted humorous way, with some heart-touching moments along the way. The series has won multiple awards, including "Outstanding Comedy Series" in 2014.

Režisierius Peter'is Berg'as ir aktorius Mark'as Wahlberg'as suvienija jėgas trileryje pagal tikrą istoriją. Po namų sąlygomis pagamintos bombos sprogimo per Bostono maratoną 2013 m. vietos policininkas Tomis Saundersas (akt. Mark Whalberg) mėgino evakuoti sužeistus piliečius, tačiau vėliau buvo pasamdytas pagelbėti surasti tuos, kurie buvo atsakingi už sprogimą. Intensyviose lenktynėse su laiku policijos komisaras Edas Deivisas (akt. John Goodman) ir specialusis agentas Richardas Des Lauriersas (akt. Kevin Bacon) perkelia paieškas iš miesto širdies į Vatertouno apylinkes. Policijos seržantas Džefris Puglisas (akt. J.K. Simmons) vadovauja paieškai priemiesčiuose, po kurios įvyksta įtemptas ir potencialiai mirtinas susidūrimas.

Jo vardas - Johnny'is Cashas, arba žmogus juodais drabužiais, kaip dainininkas dažnai buvo vadinamas. Jo prikimęs, bet galingas balsas ir grubios romantikos kupinos dainos pakeitė muzikos pasaulį. Johnny'is Cashas įgijo daugybę gerbėjų visame pasaulyje, jo geidė daugybė moterų, tačiau pats dainininkas visą gyvenimą mylėjo tik vieną vienintelę.

Iš pažiūros nekalti pono Rido namai slepia intelektualius, tačiau mirtinus spąstus, į kuriuos pakliūva dvi jaunos misionierės. Vos pabeldusios į duris, merginos atsiduria įtampos kupiname "katės ir pelės" žaidime.

Curtis LaForche gyvena mažame Ohajo miestelyje su savo žmona Samantha ir šešerių metukų kurčia dukryte Hannah. Pinigų nėra daug, ir Hannah sveikatos priežiūrą bei jos specialų išsilavinimą sunku apmokėti. Nepaisant šių sunkumų, Curtis ir Samantha yra labai įsimylėję vienas kitą ir jų šeima yra laiminga. Tačiau Curtis pradeda sapnuoti stingdančius sapnus apie ateinančią apokaliptinę audrą.
Žlungant Majų karalystei jaunas vyras išsiunčiamas į pavojingą kelionę po baimės ir priespaudos valdomą pasaulį.

Henris (aktorius Ewanas McGregoras) su žmona gydytoja Marija (aktorė Naomi Watts) bei trejais sūnumis atostogų atvyksta į Tailando Kao Lako kurortą ir pasijunta lyg patekę į rojų Žemėje: auksaspalviai smėlio paplūdimiai, skaidriai permatomas Indijos vandenyno vanduo, menkiausio debesėlio neįsileidžiantis mėlynas dangus, naktimis ryškiai tviskančios žvaiždės ir prabangūs, visus įgeidžius pildantys viešbučiai. Tačiau nuostabios ramybės idilę akimirksniu sugriauna atsiritusios milžiniškos Žemės drebėjimo Indonezijoje sukeltos vandenyno bangos, akimirksniu sužalojusios ir be žinios pradanginusios daugybę žmonių. Nevaldomai šėlstanti stichija išskiria ir Henrio bei Marijos šeimą. Sunkiai sužeista Marija pirmiausiai atranda vyriausiąjį sūnų Luką. Bandydama ką nors sužinoti apie kitus savo šeimos narius, ji neatsisako padėti dar labiau nukentėjusiems turistams ir kurorto gyventojams. Tuo tarpu per stebuklą išsigelbėjęs Henris desperatiškai ieško mylimos žmonos bei vaikų, nekreipdamas dėmesio į paniką provokuojantį chaosą bei įspėjimus apie prognozuojamą antrąją cunamio ataką.

Ashton, Celeste, and Becca are three unlikely middle school outcasts who form a club in an abandoned theater. There, they meet Charlie (Bill Cobbs, Night at the Museum), a homeless man who shares their passion for musical theater. When the theater is scheduled to be torn down, the teenagers set out to save the landmark with a modern-day performance of Shakespeare's Much Ado About Nothing. Along the way, the group learns to treat others with respect and stand up for their beliefs. This Dove-approved film also features Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Lee Meriwether.

p.t: Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding
p.d: The Prince and Me 2: The Royal Wedding continues the story of 2003's fantasy romance The Prince and Me. In the earlier film, Paige (Julia Stiles) - a midwestern college co-ed - falls in love with Edvard (Luke Mably), sans realizing that he is actually the Prince of Denmark. In this sequel, Paige (now played by neophyte Kam Heskin) and Eddie must confront a centuries-old Danish edict declaring that if a Danish prince marries a commoner, he must abdicate his throne. C.

Ever since his wife died, David struggles to get on with his teenage daughter Jules. She feels hemmed in and misunderstood, and he finds himself more and more powerless and lonely. In order to find a new partner for her dad and someone to talk to for herself, Jules creates online profiles on dating sites for David. Things suddenly take a funny turn, because although there is no shortage of candidates, they all fall short of David's ... and Jules's expectations. Will everything take a fresh turn on Christmas? A funny, heartwarming story in a wonderful Xmas mood!

A hard-working cupcake maker is inadvertently elected mayor of a small town burdened with debt. With no formal experience or education to speak of, she must rely on her street smarts to clean up the town.

p.t: 10 Things We Should Do Before We Break Up
p.d: Abigail, a self-sufficient single mom meets Ben. They both think every great relationship ends in disaster. On the first date they come up with 10 things to do together before they break up. But the estimated end is not so sure - because fate adds #11 to their list.

A space cruiser crash lands on the purple planet of Heinous, an intergalactic prison that is home to the most vile and dangerous villains in the galaxy. All of the crew have perished except for its pilot; intergalactic space hero Max Cloud, the ships hapless chef Jake, and its reluctant Commander, Rexy. Their mission is simple, wait inside their vessel until help arrives and try their best to keep the prisoners outside from getting in, however this is Max Cloud and he doesn't do simple. ...But this is not real life. This is a video-game, and at the helm of the adventure is Sarah, a teenage video game fanatic who immerses herself in fantasy to avoid dealing with her less than packed social life and a strained relationship with her dad, straight laced single parent Tony. After a fallout, Tony bans Sarah from playing games and in a frenzy of teenage emotion Sarah makes a wish, that in the blink of an eye becomes a reality... With a flash of pixelated light Sarah is transported into the video game by the mysterious Space Witch, who exists in an etherial void, behind a secret door, that never appears in the same place twice! So Sarah finds herself trapped inside the game and the only person who can help her is her equally socially defunct but incredibly charming friend, Cowboy, who must control Sarah from her bedroom in Brooklyn and keep her from losing her one life, in a game that can't be paused, that they have never finished before! To make matters worse Sarah has not found herself inside the body of the wonderful Max Cloud, but Jake, that's right... the hapless chef. We follow Sarah as she negotiates the terrifying and dangerous planet of Heinous alongside the ever confident Max and fed up Rexy, jumping back and forth with the real world as the pressure mounts on Cowboy and the real stakes start to rise. They soon encounter stranded Bounty Hunter, Brock Donnelly, and realise they must get off the planet before help arrives as the planets surface burns so hot every day that anything not underground is space liquid! AND to add to the stakes Cowboy must keep his best friend away from the evil clutches of the games villain Revengor, a part man, part machine, lunatic who is hell bent on taking Max Clouds ship and with an army of prisoners and an evil sorcersss called SHEE, his chances look pretty damn good. The action bounces between the video game and the real world as Cowboy and Sarah must come together to get her home, all leading to the ultimate showdown in Revengors lair, where back in Brooklyn, video game expertise arrives in the form of a very unlikely hero. Sit down. Plug in. It's time to play THE INTERGALACTIC ADVENTURES OF MAX CLOUD.

Sarah tells Paul that she wants out of their marriage; the next day she disappears. A year later and Paul along with their children return to his childhood town to start anew after the loss of his wife and their mother.

Remembrance depicts a remarkable love story that blossomed amidst the terror of a German concentration camp in 1944 Poland. This impossible passion fuels the courage of a Polish prisoner who manages to rescue his Jewish girlfriend. Against all odds, they escape the camp and survive a treacherous journey to freedom. But during the chaos of the end of the war, they are forcibly separated and each is convinced that the other has died. More than thirty years later in New York, the happily married 52-year-old woman accidentally finds out that her former Polish lover is still alive. And she has to see him again.
A family's Passover gets screwy after the patriarch unknowingly ingests a hit of Ecstasy.

This film is about a hyper-vigilant employee of the department of public safety who, while training his young female replacement, has to track down a missing girl who he is convinced is connected to a paroled sex offender he is investigating.

In the near future, war, climate and political agendas have robbed America of its lush resources. Seeds rarely grow into vegetation, the water is mostly polluted, and people are obligated to work hard to earn their keep. Noah Kross (Nicolas Cage) is an agent of "the Humanity Bureau," a government agency that determines a person's productivity. Kross's reports are key factors in deciding who stays in America and who is deported to New Eden. Kross is in charge of managing the deportation of a former governor of Colorado who now lives in misery, who claims to know "the truth" before seeking to kill Kross and then being shot by him. Kross ends up discovering that New Eden is really an extermination camp where the excess unproductive population is liquidated and incinerated.

Unlucky in love, living at home with her eccentric mom, and stuck in a dead end secretarial job at Judge Pharmaceuticals, Sarah Jane longs for more out of life. Her surprise promotion to junior executive appears to be just the ticket. But with promotion comes a competitive new world of wily, complicated executives, and Sarah Jane begins to eliminate the competition the only way she knows how - murder. During her climb to the top, she unexpectedly falls for the man of her dreams, Detective Bill Malloy - the cop intent on cracking the case of the mysterious deaths at Judge Pharmaceuticals.

One fine morning, Benno finds sand in his bed. While he tries to ignore this at first, he soon must realize that he himself is loosing the sand. Day after day the sand increases and soon his time literally starts running short. Finally he is left no choice but to ask Sandra for help, who runs a small coffee shop under his apartment. Although Benno hates her with a passion, he started having dreams of her every night. What could Sandra and the dreams have to do with the sand?
A former secret agent finds a treasure map and decides to find the loot. But he is not the only one.

A coming of age movie about a group of boys and girls called "adventure scouts" who return from a camping trip to discover their small town is being held captive by a gang of motorcycle-riding knuckleheads. Using only their scouting knowledge and camping equipment, the kids take down the gang members one by one, reunite with family members, and restore the community's sense of pride.

Катя и Саша дружили с детства. Но их дружбу разрушила любовь к одному мужчине – Артему, который выбрал Катю. День свадьбы должен был стать самым счастливым в жизни влюбленных, но стал последним их днем. Жестокая игра дяди Артема – Валерия, жаждущего денег и власти, едва не стоила жизни Кате и сделала несчастной Сашу. И только простив друг друга, подруги смогли все преодолеть и найти настоящую любовь. На этот раз – каждая свою...

Мечту скромной медсестры Ксении о прекрасной жизни в новом месте с любимым человеком неожиданно разбивает известие о тяжелой болезни ее мамы. Ксения вынуждена отменить свой переезд за границу и искать деньги на дорогостоящую операцию. Оставшись одна, без жилья и без работы, она пытается сделать все, что в ее силах. Неожиданно она получает предложение стать сиделкой в доме обеспеченной вдовы Ольги Болговой. Ксения с радостью принимает это предложение. Новый дом и его обитатели поначалу пугают ее, но постепенно Ксения привыкает. Она пытается наладить жизнь в доме и помочь выздороветь Ольге. К ее радости, ей начинает это удаваться. Но на самом деле Ксения еще не понимает, в какую опасную игру ее втянули….

Телеканал ТЕТ подготовил для вас нечто очень неожиданное. Проект придется по вкусу всем любителям загадочных мистических историй. События происходят в фантастическом городе Темный. В нем живут вампиры, оборотни и другие существа. Все здесь живет и дышит, даже стены домов. Попасть в этот загадочный город совсем не сложно, а вот покинуть - невероятно сложно. Однажды в город приезжает журналист. Его задача - освещать события, происходящие в Темном. Однако все осложняется тем, что отличить где правда, а где только галлюцинации, в городе бывает невероятно трудно. В каждом выпуске он расследует новые мистические дела. Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

Antroje 1951 m. pusėje Eilis Lacey palieka Airiją ir pradeda naują gyvenimą Brukline, iš ten padėdama savo šeimai. Ją sponsoriauja Tėvas Flood ir Elis netrukus pripranta prie naujojo gyvenimo, darbo parduotuvėje bei buhalterijos studijų. Kai jai pradeda simpatizuoti italų ir amerikiečių kilmės santechnikas, ji smarkiai įsimyli. Po tragiško įvykio sugrįžusi namo moteris iš naujo užmezga ryšį su savo draugais, todėl nebežino, kuris gyvenimas jai svarbesnis.

Moteris praleidusi 50 metų psichiatrinėje ligoninėje pagaliau išleidžiama praleisti paskutines gyvenimo dienas laisvėje. Gydytojas turintis patikrinti jos būklę prieš išėjimą susidomi neeilinės pacientės istorija. Jai vis labiau asiskleidžiant aiškėja vis įdomesnės detalės apie prieš daugelį metų įvykusią skaudžią meilės istoriją. Kokie atsiminimai kamuoja gyvenimui artėjant link pabaigos? Filmo "Mergina su drakono tatuiruote" žvaigžė Ro.

Paštininkas Ševalis kasdien keliauja po Dromo regioną. Sutikęs savo gyvenimo meilę Filomeną ir susilaukęs dukros Alisos jis ryžtasi beprotiškam tikslui - savo rankomis pastatyti jai neįtikėtinus rūmus.

Tai - už širdies griebianti, tikrais įvykiais paremta istorija apie 669 vaikų, daugiausiai žydų, gyvybes išgelbėjusį britą serą Nikolą Vintoną. Devintajame praėjusio amžiaus dešimtmetyje, nebeapsikentusi netvarkos vyro darbo kabinete, Gretė Vinton liepia pagaliau surasti tinkamus namus visiems jo ilgą laiką kauptiems daiktams. Tarp seniai užmirštų popierių Nikolas randa prieš 50 metų pradėtą pildyti albumą, kuriame suklijuoti laiškai, vaikų nuotraukos, surašyti jų vardai. Taip prasideda nepaprasta istorija apie Vintono žygdarbį: jaunas Londono brokeris per kelis mėnesius iki Antrojo pasaulinio karo iš nacių okupuotos Čekoslovakijos išgelbėja daugiau nei 600 vaikų.
After being released from prison, a young man reluctantly embarks on a journey with his estranged father to spread his mother's ashes in her native Ireland.

1973 m. Romoje buvo pagrobtas 16-metis Džonas, turtingiausio pasaulio žmogaus anūkas. Pagrobėjai pareikalavo 17 mln. dolerių išpirkos, bet senelis mokėti atsisakė. Desperatiškai išeities ieškanti Džono motina apie tokius pinigus net sapnuoti negali. O šykštus ir kietas buvęs uošvis apie išpirką nenori nė girdėti. Pagrindinis tokio jo sprendimo motyvas – sumokėjus nusikaltėliams, šiems atsivertų nauja "uždarbio" galimybė ir tuomet pavojuje atsidurtų visi 14 jo anūkų. Motinai į pagalbą atskuba buvęs CŽV agentas Flečeris Čeisas. Kartu su į neviltį puolusia Džono motina Flečeris bando surasti išeitį iš beviltiškos situacijos. Kino grandas Ridley'is Scott'as pasakoja kvapą gniaužiančią, pagal tikrus įvykius sukurtą istoriją – "Visi pasaulio pinigai".
